description: Check the user's current credit balance: plan tier, daily + monthly limits per credit type (validate, discover, db, profile, logo, enrich, submit), used today, remaining today, used this month, remaining this month, and any never-expiring credit pack balance. Free to call (does NOT charge a credit): call before any expensive batch (e.g. 100x discover_email) so the user knows whether they need to top up first. If they're low or ask to buy more, follow up with list_credit_packs to get pricing + a checkout URL. Requires Bearer auth; anonymous callers get a 401 with a signup link. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.
name: get_my_usage
title: Check credit balance & usage
